meta.title: Pour — without ads, without hurry
meta.description: Pour coloured water between the bottles until each holds one colour. Every level can be solved. No ads, no tracking, no accounts; works without the internet.

about.title: About the game
about.rules: The bottles hold layers of coloured water. Tap the bottle to pour from, then the one to pour into: water goes onto the same colour or into an empty bottle, as much as fits. The aim: one colour in each bottle. Every level can be solved.
about.text: No ads, no tracking, no accounts. Everything stays on this device; after the first visit the game works without the internet.
about.keys: Keys: arrows — between bottles, Enter or Space — lift or pour, Esc — put down, H — hint, Ctrl+Z — undo.
